entry.title: Awesome List Updated on Nov 03, 2026
entry.content:
1. Awesome Vue

Components & Libraries / UI Components

  • TradeCanvas (⭐28) - Vue 3 component for trading charts: candlesticks to Renko, 111 indicators, drawing tools and live exchange feeds.
  • File Viewer (⭐2.6k) - Vue 3 file-preview component with lazy renderer presets covering 275 registered extensions, including experimental formats, across Office, PDF, CAD, 3D models, and archives.
  • kritzel (⭐5) - Infinite canvas component library for Vue.

Resources / External Resources

  • FrontendAtlas Vue Interview Questions - Vue interview questions with explained answers and runnable examples; free to read, some coding exercises are paid.

Projects Using Vue.js / Open Source

  • Oxynote (⭐480) - Self-hosted collaborative documentation built with Nuxt 4, Tiptap and Yjs: live Prometheus charts as editor blocks, draft reviews with visual diffs, and an Electron desktop build.
  • EdgeChat (⭐1.4k) - Open-source team chat built with Vue 3, Vite, and Cloudflare Workers, with group and direct messages, Telegram bridging, file sharing, and WebRTC voice calls.

Projects Using Vue.js / Commercial Products

  • Beekeeper Studio - Cross-platform SQL editor and database client built with Vue.js and Electron, with a free open-source Community Edition.

Projects Using Vue.js / Apps/Websites

  • A11yKit - 15 free, client-side web accessibility and WCAG 2.2 testing tools with zero code uploads.
  • Remove Audio Tools - Over 30 free browser tools for video and audio (convert, compress, extract MP3, make GIFs, separate voice and music with AI) that process files on the device with FFmpeg.wasm and WebGPU. Built with Nuxt and Vue.

Components & Libraries / Frameworks

  • OpenVue (⭐421) - MIT-licensed Vue 3 UI component library with a complete set of themable components, forked from PrimeVue 4.5.5.

Components & Libraries / UI Utilities

  • Formhaus (⭐8) - Forms from one JSON definition for Vue and React.

Components & Libraries / Utilities

  • Lingui - Internationalization for Vue 3. Write messages in plain language right in your templates, and Lingui takes care of the rest.
  • vue-qs (⭐25) - Type-safe URL query state for Vue 3 and Nuxt, a port of nuqs. Writable refs synced with the search params, with typed parsers, batching and throttling.

Components & Libraries / Dev Tools

  • vue-why-render (⭐12) - shows why Vue 3 components re-render: highlights renders on the page and names the cause (props, state, Pinia stores, route changes, computeds), with a panel and a Nuxt module.

2. Discount for Student Dev

Infrastructure Monitoring

  • Kilobat [FREE] - macOS network monitoring app; eligible students aged 13+ get one year of Pro for two Macs with a school email, renewable while studying.

Software Packs

  • Student AI Deals [FREE] - A verified list of AI tools and credits students can get free with a student email or GitHub Education, such as Copilot Pro, Azure for Students and JetBrains, with the exact requirements for each.

3. Awesome Rails

DevTools / Other external resources

  • TestMu AI HyperExecute - Run Capybara browser tests on TestMu AI's test orchestration cloud.

4. Awesome Svelte

Internationalization / Form Components

  • svelte-intlayer (⭐863) - Per-component i18n focused on bundle size. Declarative + compiler based i18n.

5. Awesome Healthcare

Contents / EHR

  • Akello (⭐42) - Integrated Mental Health Infrastructure
  • Beda EMR (⭐132) - EMR built natively on FHIR.
  • BHIMA (⭐234) - Hospital information and accounting system for rural hospitals.
  • CARE (⭐419) - Digital public good for hospital administration and decentralized patient care.
  • FerroEHR (⭐85) - openEHR Clinical Data Repository written in Rust, with ITS-REST and AQL support on PostgreSQL.
  • GitEHR (⭐6) - Patient-owned, self-hostable EHR stored as plain-text files in a Git repository. Append-only journal, immutable documents, offline-first, no database.
  • HasteHealth (⭐85) - Scalable FHIR server and clinical data repository.
  • ICTHospital (⭐115) - Hospital management software with built-in unified communications, built on Laravel.
  • Marley (⭐555) - Health information system built on the Frappe framework.
  • Open Hospital (⭐638) - Electronic Medical Record software for underprivileged rural hospitals.

Contents / Scribe

  • Phlox (⭐110) - Open source (MIT), self-hosted AI medical scribe with realtime note drafting, RAG, and MCP-extensible agents; runs as a desktop app or Docker image.

Contents / Imaging

  • Cornerstone3D (⭐1.2k) - JavaScript libraries for building web-based medical imaging platforms.
  • dcm2niix (⭐1.2k) - DICOM to NIfTI converter.
  • highdicom (⭐241) - High-level DICOM abstractions for Python, including segmentations, structured reports and annotations.
  • Horos (⭐643) - Medical image viewer.
  • MedPy (⭐623) - Python library for medical image processing, supporting DICOM and NIfTI formats with tools for segmentation, filtering, and feature extraction.
  • mercure (⭐104) - DICOM orchestrator for routing and processing imaging studies.
  • MONAI Label (⭐908) - AI-assisted image labeling tool that works with 3D Slicer and OHIF.
  • PyMedPhys (⭐368) - Community library for medical physics.
  • QuPath (⭐1.5k) - Bioimage analysis and whole slide image analysis for digital pathology.
  • SlicerDMRI (⭐86) - Extension for 3D Slicer focused on diffusion MRI analysis and visualization, supporting neuroscience research.
  • Weasis (⭐1.4k) - Standalone and web-based DICOM viewer.

Contents / Dental

  • DentalPin (⭐110) - Dental practice management with an AI agent that runs real operations.

Contents / Laboratory

  • MISO (⭐316) - Laboratory information management system for NGS sequencing centres.

Contents / Frameworks

  • CHT - Community Health Toolkit - set of Open Source tools that support community healthcare
  • HAPI FHIR JPA Server Starter (⭐544) - Ready-to-deploy FHIR server built on HAPI FHIR.
  • Helios FHIR Server (⭐57) - FHIR server written in Rust, optimized for clinical analytics workloads.
  • Opal (⭐288) - Framework for building clinical applications.
  • Spezi (⭐261) - Stanford framework for building interoperable digital health apps on Apple platforms.

Contents / Libraries

  • dcmjs (⭐356) - JavaScript implementation of DICOM manipulation.
  • deid (⭐182) - De-identification of DICOM images in Python.
  • dicom-rs (⭐570) - Rust implementation of the DICOM standard.
  • fhir.resources (⭐543) - Pydantic-based FHIR resource models for Python.
  • fhir-py (⭐218) - Async and sync FHIR client for Python.
  • HealthChain (⭐230) - Python SDK for building healthcare AI applications with FHIR tools and real-time EHR connectivity.
  • MITK - The Medical Imaging Interaction Toolkit.
  • nHapi (⭐313) - .NET port of the HAPI HL7 v2 library.
  • nhs-number (⭐6) - A Clojure/Script library providing validation, formatting and generation of UK NHS Numbers
  • nhs-number (⭐14) - Python package to provide utilities for NHS Numbers, including validity checks, normalisation, and generation.
  • Pydicom (⭐2.2k) - Pure Python package for working with DICOM files, enabling reading, writing, and manipulation of medical imaging data.
  • sct (⭐32) - File-based SNOMED-CT toolset built in Rust.
  • SMART on FHIR JavaScript client (⭐355) - JavaScript client for SMART on FHIR apps.

Contents / Applications

  • AirwayLab (⭐45) - Browser-based airway analysis dashboard for PAP therapy users with flow limitation scoring, breathing pattern analysis, and oximetry metrics.
  • CommCare HQ (⭐525) - Server for CommCare, a mobile data collection platform for frontline health workers.
  • MedTimer (⭐648) - Medication reminder and tracking app for Android.
  • OpenSRP FHIR Core (⭐70) - Offline-capable Android app for community health workers, built on the Android FHIR SDK.
  • RCPCH Digital Growth Charts - Open source Digital Growth Charts platform with API, CLI, Python package, React chart components.
  • SORMAS (⭐334) - Surveillance, outbreak response management and analysis system.

Contents / PHR

  • AndroidAPS (⭐1.2k) - Open source automated insulin delivery system for Android.
  • Loop (⭐1.8k) - Automated insulin delivery app for iOS.
  • Nightscout (⭐2.9k) - Web monitor for continuous glucose monitor data.
  • OpenHealth (⭐4k) - Privacy-first AI health assistant that interprets personal health data (blood tests, checkups, family history, symptoms) with local LLM support via Ollama.
  • Trio (⭐419) - Automated insulin delivery system for iOS based on the OpenAPS algorithm.
  • xDrip+ (⭐1.8k) - Android app for collecting and displaying continuous glucose monitor data.

Contents / Research

  • admiral (⭐324) - R package from pharmaverse for creating ADaM clinical trial datasets.
  • LibreClinica (⭐83) - Electronic data capture for clinical trials, community successor of OpenClinica.
  • OHDSI ATLAS (⭐335) - Web tool for observational research on OMOP CDM data.

Contents / Integration

  • LinuxForHealth HL7v2-FHIR Converter (⭐110) - Converts HL7 v2 messages to FHIR resources.
  • mirthSync (⭐104) - CLI for putting Mirth Connect and Open Integration Engine configuration under version control.
  • Open Integration Engine (⭐240) - Community open source fork of Mirth Connect.

Contents / Bioinformatics

  • cBioPortal (⭐1.1k) - Platform for exploring and visualizing cancer genomics data.
  • GATK (⭐2k) - Broad Institute toolkit for variant discovery in high-throughput sequencing data.
  • Hail (⭐1.1k) - Scalable genomic data analysis.
  • nf-core/sarek (⭐616) - Pipeline to detect germline and somatic variants from sequencing data.
  • scikit-bio (⭐1.3k) - Python library for bioinformatics, providing tools for sequence analysis, microbiome studies, and statistical analysis of biological data.

Contents / Data

  • DHIS2 (⭐360) - Health information management platform used by national health systems.
  • medspaCy (⭐684) - Library for clinical NLP with spaCy.
  • OpenMRS FHIR Analytics (⭐228) - Pipeline tools for transforming OpenMRS data to FHIR-based analytics using Apache Beam.
  • Pathling (⭐140) - FHIR and clinical terminology analytics on Apache Spark.
  • Snowstorm (⭐399) - SNOMED International's SNOMED CT terminology server.
  • Tuva (⭐333) - Open source data model, data marts and data quality tests for claims and clinical data.

Contents / Machine learning

  • nnU-Net (⭐9k) - Self-configuring deep learning framework for biomedical image segmentation.
  • Odyssey (⭐63) - Interpretable foundation model of the patient clinical timeline for event forecasting and time-to-event prediction.
  • OpenMed (⭐5.8k) - Local clinical named-entity recognition and PHI de-identification models.
  • PathML (⭐467) - Python library for digital pathology image analysis, providing tools for preprocessing, model training, and analysis of histological slides.
  • seismometer (⭐272) - Epic's framework for evaluating AI models in healthcare.
  • TorchIO (⭐2.5k) - Medical image preprocessing and augmentation for deep learning.
  • TotalSegmentator (⭐3.1k) - Segmentation of more than 100 anatomical structures in CT and MR images.

Contents / Compliance

  • HealthStack (⭐94) - Terraform modules for secure and compliant healthcare infrastructure on AWS.

6. Awesome Go

Databases / SQL Query Builders

  • doug-martin/goqu (⭐2.7k) — SQL builder and query library for golang ☆2,676

7. Awesome Zsh Plugins

Plugins / superconsole - Windows-only

  • claude-guard (⭐0) - checks your egress IP before Claude Code starts. If the IP that claude.ai sees is not on your allowlist, claude stops and asks before it connects.
  • sprout (⭐1) - Turn a Jira ticket into a clean git branch. One command. A short, descriptive name. Zero copy-pasting.
  • walh-shell (⭐2) - A fast, modern, and extensible Zsh (and Bash) plugin for instant terminal color theme switching that lets you instantly change your terminal’s color scheme with a single command.

8. Awesome Lowcode

AI

  • kdpbook.io - No-code AI book studio: describe a book in a chat and get it written, illustrated and typeset, with the Amazon KDP print PDF, full-wrap cover, Kindle eBook and listing sheet.
  • Pinegen AI - Generate, fix, and backtest compiler-validated Pine Script v6 strategies for TradingView using AI. Free to start, no coding needed.

Automation

  • Upload-Post - Social media publishing API for posting and scheduling to TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, X, and more. Integrates with Zapier, Make, and n8n, and has an MCP server. Free plan available.

Educational

  • Benian n8n Automation Catalog - n8n workflow examples with setup guides and runnable walkthroughs using fictional data.

Flow-based programming

  • Ciaren - Open-source, local-first visual ETL and ML workflow builder that exports readable pandas or Polars code.

Marketing

  • thirds.ai - Make branded images and PDFs from editable templates in a studio, AI assistant, or API.
  • Stripo - No-code email design platform with 1,690+ templates and export to 90+ ESPs.

Online database creator apps

  • Nhost - Open source Postgres backend with a dashboard for tables and permissions, an instant GraphQL API, auth, storage and functions.
  • PHPRunner - Commercial low-code builder for web applications using existing databases, with forms, reports, permissions, and deployment to your own web server.

Visual programming

  • Figment.so - Publish Figma designs as websites through a Figma plugin.
  • Helmpages - Websites for independent professionals and small businesses, built and kept current by sending a message. Paid, with a free trial.
  • HtmlDrag - Visual editor for existing and AI-generated HTML pages, with drag-and-drop editing, element-level AI refinement, and HTML export.
  • BuzzBlender Kiosk Editor - No-code kiosk interface builder for creating button-based experiences with video, images and text, with preview and standalone HTML export.

Misc

  • BESSER (⭐200) - Open-source Python low-code platform: draw a UML model in a web editor and generate FastAPI, React, Django and SQLAlchemy code.
  • BESSER Agentic Framework (⭐71) - Design and implement agents and chatbots in Python.

9. Awesome Privacy

Desktop

  • BusKill - BusKill is a Dead Man Switch triggered when a magnetic breakaway is tripped, severing a USB connection.
  • OpenSnitch (⭐14k) - Interactive application firewall for GNU/Linux that helps users detect, monitor, and block unwanted outbound connections.
  • dnscrypt-proxy (⭐14k) - Local DNS proxy supporting DNSCrypt, DoH and Anonymized DNS relays, so resolvers cannot link queries to your IP. ISC licensed.
  • MAT2 (⭐387) - Removes metadata from images, documents, audio and other files. Command line tool with file manager integrations.
  • Metadata Cleaner - Simple desktop app to view and remove file metadata, built on MAT2.
  • Mobile Verification Toolkit (⭐16k) - Forensic tool from Amnesty International that checks Android and iOS devices for traces of spyware such as Pegasus.

10. Collective Ai Tools

Developer Tools

  • Browser Agent Blueprint (⭐1) - Open-source browser agent prompt modules and synthetic recovery examples for uncertain actions. #free #opensource
  • Keenable - Independent web search index for AI agents: search and page fetch over API, CLI and MCP (https://api.keenable.ai/mcp), with 100K free requests a month and keyless public endpoints. #freemium #api #mcp
  • Model Salt - Open source MCP server with one tool: before a creative task the model gets a few choices drawn from atmospheric and quantum noise, so one prompt gives different answers that still do what was asked. #free #opensource #mcp
  • SoloPup Memory (⭐1) - Native DeepSeek Harness text-memory beta with source references, project scope and correction history; requires Node >=24.9 and DSH >=0.2.1-rc.0 <0.3.0, and configured model APIs may charge. #opensource #memory

Image Editing

  • Clarpex AI - Free online AI photo fixer to unblur, restore old photos, colorize black and white photos, remove glare and upscale to 4K or 8K, with daily free credits and no sign-up. #freemium #photo

Image Generator

  • MakeImg - AI photo generator that turns a text prompt or reference photo into a new image, with 11 models and free daily credits. #freemium #image
  • QuestStudio - Generate and edit images, then continue related video, voice, and music workflows in a connected creative studio. #paid #design

Video

  • RefVid - Generates AI videos from 1–5 reference photos of a character or product, using the photos to help maintain character or product consistency. New accounts get one free 5-second clip, then paid credits or plans. #paid

Writing

  • CoverNice - KDP cover studio: five directions, spine width from page count, 300 dpi wrap PDF. #freemium

11. Awesome Gemini Cli

Agent Orchestration & CLI Tools

  • EndoStack (⭐4) - Security-first workflows for coding agents: 62 skills that threat-model changes, security-review diffs and verify results by running them. Works in Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and 11 other agents. MIT.
  • Preloop (⭐85) - Open-source AI agent control plane and software factory: every tool and model call allowed, denied or held for a human, budgeted and recorded, and agents run from tickets, webhooks and CI in hosted containers or on your own runners, landing work as pull requests. Works with Gemini CLI, Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, OpenCode and Copilot CLI. Apache-2.0.
  • AgentVera - Desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux that runs Gemini CLI side by side with Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Cursor and 13 more coding agents per project, each in a real terminal using your own Gemini CLI install and login. A team kanban board hands cards to agents, and an MCP manager is built in. Closed source; free plan, Pro $9.99/month.

MCP Servers

  • Keenable (⭐2) - Web search and page fetch as clean Markdown from Keenable, a search engine with its own crawler and index built for AI agents. Gemini CLI extension that adds Keenable's hosted MCP server (search_web_pages, fetch_page_content) and a web-lookup skill; keyless, no signup or API key (rate limited per IP). MIT. Install: gemini extensions install https://github.com/keenableai/keenable-antigravity.
  • repofit (⭐4) - MCP server and CLI that reads what local coding agents already keep (Gemini CLI chats and GEMINI.md, plus Codex, Claude Code, Cursor and others) and recommends GitHub projects for the tasks you repeat, each pick citing the session it came from. Also lists installed MCP servers and skills that no session ever called. Runs locally and uses the agent's own model, so no API key. MIT. Add with gemini mcp add repofit uvx repofit mcp.

12. Magictools

Graphics / Assets/Placeholders

  • 🆓 Minecraft Pixel Art - Browser image-to-Minecraft block blueprints with material lists, PNG plans and Java structure NBT export; no account required.

Graphics / Spritesheet Tools

  • 🆓 SpriteCanvas Sprite Sheet Tools - Free browser tools that slice a sprite sheet into frames, pack images into a sheet, convert GIFs to sheets and back, and turn MP4/WebM clips into sheets with a JSON atlas. Files stay on your device; no account needed.

AI / Voxel Editors

  • 💸 Flockbay - Free AI game maker built on Godot: a desktop app where an AI agent builds and playtests a Godot 4 project on your disk, on free hosted AI, your own Claude or ChatGPT account, or your own agent over MCP. Optional paid plans add hosted AI usage.
  • 💸 SpriteCanvas - AI sprite animation generator for 2D games: make a character from text or an image, animate idle, walk, run, jump and attack moves, and export transparent PNG sprite sheets with a JSON atlas for Phaser, PixiJS and Godot. Free daily credits.

13. Awesome Rust

Applications / Virtualization

  • terrarium-sh/terrarium (⭐52) - Portable minimal microVM sandbox for agents and development tools on Linux, macOS and Windows Terrarium

14. Awesome Neovim

Game / Tmux

  • navasvarela/vimdojo (⭐0) - Puzzle game for learning Vim motions and workflows, scored on keystrokes against par.

15. Tools

UI Builders

  • Particle Logo - Turn a logo into a particle animation in the browser, then export dependency-free HTML, Vue 3 and React components, or video and GIF.

16. Awesome Mac

Developer Tools / Developer Utilities

  • Breaker (⭐0) - Watches the launchd jobs, cron jobs, Folder Actions, and SwiftBar plugins you set up yourself and notifies you when one breaks.
  • mirroir-mcp - Open-source MCP server and CLI that lets AI agents see, tap, swipe and type on a real iPhone through iPhone Mirroring, without Developer Mode or Xcode.

AI Tools / Other Tools

  • Murmury (⭐1) - Floating window that answers questions from your own documents during video calls, hidden from screen sharing, with on-device speech recognition.

Audio and Video Tools / File Sharing

  • MP4Flow - Native FFmpeg front end for batch video-to-MP4 conversion, trimming, cropping, rotating, and merging.

Audio and Video Tools / Audio Record and Process

  • Carbon - Menu bar app that transcribes meetings on device and saves each one as a Markdown file, with no bot and no cloud.

Utilities / Menu Bar Tools

  • AI Footprint - Read-only menu bar app that shows the disk space, background processes, MCP servers and login items AI coding tools leave on your Mac, with a receipt for every update.
  • Vortex - MacBook notch app with a focus timer, clipboard history, a file shelf that catches new builds, screen-to-task capture with OCR, and keys Claude Code can use without seeing them.

Utilities / Cleanup and Uninstall

  • RefreshYourMac - Mac cleaner that rates every category Safe to Remove, Review, Move to Backup or Protected, and shows what left it behind before anything is deleted.

Utilities / Window Management

  • Switch - Keyboard window switcher that lists every open window across Spaces and filters as you type.

Utilities / System Related Tools

  • TimeMachineEjector (⭐1) - Menu bar app that ejects your Time Machine backup disk when a backup finishes and mounts it again when a scheduled backup is due.

17. Awesome Testing

Software / API Testing

  • Bifurc (⭐4) - Local-first API client, mock server and traffic proxy for macOS, Windows and Linux, with a CLI for CI.

Software / Test Automation Frameworks

  • bareenv (⭐0) - Runs a command once per environment combination (unset, empty, invalid) and reports the ones that break.

entry.title: Awesome List Updated on Nov 02, 2026
entry.content:
1. Awesome Selfhosted

Software / Document Management - E-books

  • Tome - Ebook and manga library server with web reader, OPDS and metadata fetching. A KOReader plugin records every reading session and syncs positions both ways, powering streaks, pace, heatmaps and per-book stats. (Source Code (⭐108), Clients (⭐108)) AGPL-3.0 Docker

Software / File Transfer - Object Storage & File Servers

  • s3-orchestrator - Storage orchestration layer presenting many cloud providers as a single S3 endpoint, keeping N copies across them with read failover, plus optional per-backend byte, request, ingress and egress limits, zstd compression and envelope encryption. (Source Code (⭐45)) MIT Go/Docker/deb/K8S

Software / File Transfer - Peer-to-peer Filesharing

  • DashBeam - File transfer tool with peer-to-peer networking, letting you transfer any file with any size. (Demo, Source Code (⭐10k)) AGPL-3.0 deb/Docker

2. Awesome Smart Tv

Android TV / Tools

  • TV Box Tools (⭐18) - Launcher manager and ADB toolbox for Android TV and Google TV boxes: set the HOME app, kiosk, speed-up, display, remote, console, MCP server.

3. Awesome Nextjs

Boilerplates

  • Midnight Lite (⭐0) - Free dark landing page template for AI and SaaS products with Next.js 16, Tailwind CSS v4 and shadcn/ui. MIT licensed. Demo

4. Awesome Web Security

Fingerprint

  • Passive OS Fingerprinting: TCP Fingerprint, p0f and JA4T - How the first TCP SYN gives away the operating system family, why a proxy shows up as a mismatch with the OS the browser reports, and how p0f and JA4T record the same packet. Written by packet.guru.

JWT

  • How to revoke a JWT, from a system that does it - A per-user revocation cut-off from a production multi-tenant app: why it compares against auth_time rather than iat, the whole-seconds rounding bug it shipped with, and the routes that trusted the token. Written by Ridam Agrawal.

SSRF

  • Instance Metadata Abuse - Shows how a server-side request forgery bug becomes cloud credential theft through the instance metadata service, and why requiring IMDSv2 session tokens with a response hop limit in the instance configuration closes the whole class of forging bugs rather than one code path, by RansomLeak.

Scanning / Sub Domain Enumeration

  • ONUS (⭐12) - Web vulnerability assessment platform that orchestrates multiple scanners, applies deterministic CVSS v3.1 scoring, and provides AI-assisted vulnerability analysis and remediation guidance.
  • Crossfyre Toolchain (⭐256) - Recon and vulnerability scanning engines in Rust for subdomains, ports, content discovery, fingerprinting, injection testing and nuclei-style templates, with one CLI and newline-delimited JSON output by @clickswave.

Decompiler / Server-Side Request Forgery

  • Wakaru (⭐1.1k) - JavaScript decompiler that splits production bundles from webpack, esbuild, Browserify, and Metro into modules and turns minified and transpiled code back into readable JavaScript, without executing it, by @pionxzh.

5. Awesome Polars

Polars plugins / Finance

  • polars-talib-fast (⭐0) - Every TA-Lib function (237) as a Polars expression, on TA-Lib's official Rust port, with TA-Lib's default parameters and output names by @meet-brad-ch.

Cheat Sheets / Miscellaneous

  • Polars Cheat Sheet (CheatGrid) - A free Polars reference covering expressions, lazy vs eager execution, joins, window functions and streaming by CheatGrid.

Tutorials & workshops / Miscellaneous

  • U.S. bank analysis with Polars and DuckDB (⭐1) - A runnable notebook on lazy Parquet scans, validated identity joins, missing-value handling, and SQL reconciliation using a frozen FDIC bank dataset.

6. Awesome Developer First

CI/CD

  • Buddy - CI/CD pipelines, sandbox VMs, hosting and git repositories for AI coding agents.

Scraping

  • Browser Use - Cloud browsers and web agents for AI, controlled over API, SDK or CDP.

7. Awesome Privacy

2FA

  • Microsoft Authenticator

Android SMS

  • Fossify Messages (⭐1.6k) - Simple SMS and MMS app for Android with no ads, tracking or internet access. GPL-3.0 licensed.
  • QUIK (⭐2.9k) - Maintained fork of QKSMS, a clean SMS and MMS messenger for Android. GPL-3.0 licensed.

Automation

  • Zapier
  • IFTTT
  • Huginn (⭐50k) - Self-hosted agents that watch websites, feeds and APIs and act on your behalf, an alternative to IFTTT and Zapier. MIT licensed.

Cloud Storage

  • Filen - Zero-knowledge, end-to-end encrypted cloud storage from Germany with open source desktop, mobile and web clients.
  • Sync-in (⭐1.9k) - Self-hosted file storage, sharing and sync platform with WebDAV, desktop sync clients and Collabora or OnlyOffice editing. AGPL-3.0 licensed.
  • git-annex - Manages and syncs large files with git without storing their contents in git, across drives and many cloud and offline backends. AGPL-3.0 licensed.

IDEs

  • GNU Emacs - Extensible, customizable free software text editor and IDE maintained by the GNU Project. GPL-3.0 licensed.

Photoshop / Illustrator

  • LibreSprite (⭐8.7k) - Free and open source sprite editor and pixel-art animation tool, forked from Aseprite before its license change. GPL-2.0 licensed.

Encryption

  • BitLocker - Proprietary Microsoft disk encryption. With device encryption, Windows uploads your recovery key to your Microsoft account by default.

Mario Kart

  • Dr. Robotnik's Ring Racers - Technical kart racer and sequel to SRB2Kart, built on the Sonic Robo Blast 2 engine. GPL-2.0 licensed.

Minecraft

  • Cubyz (⭐3.7k) - Voxel sandbox game inspired by Minecraft with far view distances, 3D chunks and procedural crafting. GPL-3.0 licensed.

Plugins for Minecraft

  • Prism Launcher (⭐11k) - Open source Minecraft launcher for managing multiple instances and mods without the official launcher. GPL-3.0 licensed.

Unity / Unreal Engine

  • Godot Engine (⭐119k) - Free and open source 2D and 3D game engine with no account, royalties or telemetry. MIT licensed.

Centralized

Office

Android-Based

Smart TV

Imgur

Utilities

Anti-tracking / Alternative clients/modifications of Discord:

    • Read the extension docs (⭐69k) and pick one of the recommended modes to increase your privacy.

8. Awesome Gemini Cli

Commands & Extensions

Zero runtime dependencies, MIT. Install with gemini extensions install https://github.com/Quinnod345/ponder or npx skills add Quinnod345/ponder -y -a gemini-cli.

Education & Study Tools

  • mock-interview (⭐2) - Agent Skill that runs in Gemini CLI and other agents (npx skills add georgesmomo/mock-interview). Runs a realistic mock job interview for any role, with research on the job and real follow-up questions, then gives an honest score out of 10 and a written report.

MCP Servers

  • mach-gtm-mcp (⭐1) - Open-source B2B outbound sales MCP server: build ICPs, research prospects with verified buying signals, score leads (0-100), draft cold emails and LinkedIn messages (1-3-1 framework), and generate multi-touch sequences. Human approval required before any message is sent. Works with Gemini CLI and any MCP client. Install: npx mach-gtm-mcp.

9. Awesome Rust

Applications / MLOps

A Rust port of CLIProxyAPI.

Applications / System tools

Applications / Video

Applications / Web

Libraries / Game development

  • rornic/ochre (⭐51) - A voxel world tech demo with a 64km erosion-carved terrain of rivers, lakes and seas, streamed with octree LODs out to 32km

10. Tools

Tools collection

  • cv.cm - 110+ free tools that run in the browser: JSON formatter, Base64, hash, JWT decoder, regex tester, cron and timestamp converters, plus image resize/convert, PDF merge/split, QR codes and a few device tests (mic, keyboard). No sign-up, 8 languages.

11. Free for Dev

Monitoring

Crash and Exception Handling

Analytics, Events and Statistics

  • Datasense - Web analytics with JavaScript error tracking, goals, and revenue attribution. Free plan: 1 site, 5,000 events per month.

Screenshot APIs

  • Shotlane - Screenshots, clean Markdown and PDFs of any web page, rendered in current Chrome. Hide cookie banners, ads and other popups and many more options. A free account gives you 100 credits per month, no card required.

Design and Product / Other Tools

Audio and Video Tools / Audio Record and Process

  • jdsp4mac (⭐1) - Menu bar app that runs JamesDSP audio effects, including EQ, AutoEQ, convolver, crossfeed and ViPER-DDC, on all system audio.

Input Methods / Audio Record and Process

  • Sidekey - Use your iPhone as a wireless keyboard, trackpad and voice input for your Mac or Windows PC over local Wi-Fi.

Utilities / Cleanup and Uninstall

  • ShinyMac (⭐1) - Open-source SwiftUI Mac cleaner with one-scan Smart Care, an app uninstaller that finds leftovers, Xcode cleanup, a Space Lens disk map and hidden settings.

Software / UI & End-to-End Testing

  • mendwright (⭐0) - Self-healing selectors for Playwright and Selenium in Python. Repairs a broken selector from a saved fingerprint of the element, asks a model only when that isn't enough, checks the repair on the live page and can write it back into your code.

1. Awesome Testing

Software / UI & End-to-End Testing

  • Device Hub Pro (⭐136) - Free, open-source macOS app for manual testing on Android emulators, Android phones and iOS simulators side by side, with live mirroring, device controls (network, location, permissions, deep links, push), logs, screenshots and screen recordings.
  • ai-wright (⭐1) - Open-source library that adds AI action, assertion, and data extraction steps to Playwright tests, using annotated screenshots and your own OpenAI, Gemini, or Claude API key.
  • blastproof - Open-source AI agent that runs plain-English e2e tests in a real browser. It reads the pull request diff, runs only the tests for the pages that changed and can block the merge on a score. Runs locally or in CI with your own LLM key.
  • Browser Use (⭐120k) - Open-source (MIT) Python AI agent that runs plain-English tasks in a real browser. Browser Use Cloud adds hosted stealth Chromium you can drive over CDP from Playwright, Puppeteer or Selenium, with session recordings and live view.
  • cloudf.one - Rent a real Samsung Android phone in Singapore on a Singtel or M1 SIM and use it from a browser tab, to check how an app behaves for Singapore users. Manual use only, no Appium or scripts.
  • Clousd - Cloud Android phones (150+ device models, Android 12-17) for app testing in a browser tab, over ADB, or through a REST API and MCP server for AI-driven tests.
  • ContextQA MCP - Hosted MCP server for creating and running end-to-end tests and investigating failures, with OAuth browser sign-in.
  • Drengr - Mobile tests written as plain-English tasks instead of selectors, driven by an agent on real Android devices and iOS simulators. Works where there is no accessibility tree — canvas, games, Flutter without semantics labels — by falling back to vision and coordinates. Runs locally or in CI; bring your own model key.
  • Drengr Runner (⭐1) - Drive an iOS simulator over HTTP from any language. A 479-line Swift XCTest target replacing WebDriverAgent on simulators. Apache-2.0.
  • Proxy QA Browser (⭐1) - Free, open-source desktop app to test your own web forms by US location, emulated device and browser, with recorded scenarios, consent and accessibility checks, and a CI runner.
  • vibe-testing (⭐17) - Open-source MCP server and CLI that scans web app routes and forms, runs browser checks with Playwright, and produces HTML QA reports.
  • VibeView - Run & test iOS, Android, Apple TV and Android TV apps right in your browser, with Roku in beta. Build tests by recording a flow or write steps in plain English, flows can be ran cross-platform, and wired into pull requests. When a step fails - AI agent takes over so the rest of the run still completes, and the report tells you what changed based on failed steps and visual diff.
  • assay (⭐108) - Deterministic command-line QA tool that serves a local web page, drives every control it finds in Chromium through Playwright. No tests to write and no LLM, with a Python API, an HTML report, and a plugin for AI coding agent. MIT, Python.
  • Device Changer - Applies device models, build fingerprints and identifiers to rooted Android test devices to reproduce device-specific bugs.

Software / Accessibility & Usability Testing

  • Oh My Android (⭐73) - Free, open-source macOS app for checking Android apps on emulators and phones in dark mode, large font sizes, RTL and TalkBack, with a TalkBack-order accessibility audit.
  • AuditReady - Runs 12 deterministic HTML checks on a page against WCAG 2.2 and returns the matching criterion and a suggested fix for each finding, then turns them into a printable report an agency can hand to its client. Free instant scan; the full report is a one-off $29.
  • Barbwire - Sends AI buyer personas built from your site through the live pages in a real browser, and reports where each one would stop buying, with a step-by-step replay, screenshots and fixes ranked worst first. 10 free runs, no card; paid plans from €49/month.
  • RateMyApp Testing Brief Builder - Free, no-account tool for writing mobile usability-testing tasks, expected outcomes, and feedback instructions.
  • Site Spell Checker - Crawls a live website and flags spelling and grammar mistakes on every page, each shown in context with its page URL. Free one-page scan; the full-site scan is a one-off $99.

Software / API Testing

  • API Spector - Open-source API clien, mock server and contract testing tool. Zero telemetry.
  • Openhook (⭐2) - Open-source webhook inbox for capturing callbacks and inspecting request headers and bodies through a browser, REST API, or MCP.
  • SolidPing (⭐26) - Open-source (AGPL-3.0) uptime and API monitoring with a free hosted tier. Runs HTTP, gRPC, WebSocket and custom JS checks on a schedule and alerts when an endpoint fails.
  • BestJSON JSON Diff - Free browser tool for comparing saved JSON API responses by structure, with explicit array-order and record-ID matching rules.
  • Kerno - The AI Backend Runtime QA Engineer. Runs locally inside your coding agent's loop through MCP and tests each change against your running app and its real databases, queues and services.
  • OpenAPI Breaking Change Checker - Free browser tool that compares two Swagger 2.0 or OpenAPI 3.0/3.1 descriptions (JSON or YAML) and sorts each change into likely breaking, review-needed or compatible; the files stay in the browser.

Software / Security Testing

  • Darkmoon (⭐1.1k) - Open-source (GPLv3) autonomous AI penetration-testing CLI with 50 specialist agents and 140+ offensive tools over MCP for DAST-style web and API security assessment.

Software / AI & LLM Testing

  • geokit-cli (⭐0) - Open-source CLI for automated AI search engine readiness testing, /llms.txt validation, and crawler access audits.
  • aiexpect (⭐2) - Python assertions for non-deterministic AI text that drop into pytest. Semantic and rule checks work offline; optional LLM judge with your own model; produces a Trust Score and a single-file HTML report.
  • OrcaReplay (⭐281) - Records a coding-agent session below the harness, keeping the verbatim request and response bytes, then replays the same run offline with the network off or forks it from a checkpoint onto other models with a verify command deciding the verdict.
  • flight-recorder (⭐1) - Record every nondeterministic input your code reads (LLM answers, HTTP, database, clock, randomness) as one JSONL tape per request, then replay the tape against the real code offline, bit for bit, with the first divergence named. Open format with Python, Node, .NET, Go, Java and PHP implementations.
  • OrcaPromptVault (⭐80) - Dated archive of the system prompts and tool-call schemas shipped AI agents send, so tests can be written against a product's real declared tool surface rather than a guess at it.
  • fanout-check (⭐1) - Offline Python library and CLI that checks observed concurrency, overlap, and launch timing in explicitly grouped tool or agent calls.

Software / Service Virtualization

  • MockForge (⭐12) - Open-source API mock server written in Rust for HTTP/OpenAPI, gRPC, GraphQL, WebSocket, Kafka, MQTT and AMQP, with data generation and latency/fault injection.
  • Twinbay - Hosted, stateful twins of third-party APIs such as Shopify, Slack, Zendesk and QuickBooks for integration and AI agent tests. Each test run gets a private URL, and directives force states like rate limits or failed payments.
  • fieldtwin - Open-source, local, stateful twins of the Jobber and QuickBooks Online APIs for integration and AI agent tests, with checkpoints, rewind, and faults on demand.
  • OutageFence (⭐0) - Local HTTP fault-injection CLI by Slanta Cause that checks synthetic sensitive data against declared destination rules, with positive controls and offline reports.

Software / Visual Testing

  • CurlShot - Screenshot API for capturing baseline and comparison images of web pages in CI as PNG, JPEG, WebP or PDF, with full-page and CSS-selector element capture, device presets and ad/cookie-banner blocking. Free plan available.
  • cloneproof (⭐0) - Scores how closely a website clone matches the original (pixels, layout, style, scroll motion) with Playwright and lists the exact differences.

Software / Test Report Diagnostics

  • junit-collision-check (⭐0) - Offline Python CLI that detects duplicate test identities and conflicting outcomes across JUnit XML reports before CI report ingestion.

Software / Test Management

  • qarunbook - Free shared test runbook where testers record a pass or fail per platform with screenshots, and an issue marked fixed sends the check back for a retest.

Software / Test Data Management

  • 8½ Minute Mail - Receive-only temporary inbox for manual email verification testing, with an 8-minute-30-second default lifetime and no account required.
  • TempMail Hub - Free disposable inbox for manual or scripted signup and email-verification testing, with a selectable lifetime from 10 minutes to 7 days and no account required.
  • Checklist kiểm thử Web tiếng Việt (⭐0) - Vietnamese-language web form and login testing checklist with copy-paste Vietnamese test data (diacritics, NFC/NFD, +84 phone numbers).
  • Mails.ai - Email inboxes for automated tests: a plus address per test and one call that waits for the email and returns the sign-up code or magic link, with TypeScript and Python SDKs, Cypress and Playwright packages and an MCP server.
  • mailsocket - Inbox API that waits for an email OTP or magic link and returns it as JSON, with Python and TypeScript SDKs and an MCP server.
  • Personified (⭐1) - Free AI avatar photos of fictional people with typed personas (name, country, age band, mood) for seed data and placeholder users. MIT code, npm package.
  • ARADURU File Format Test Corpus - Open CC0 corpus of deterministic healthy and intentionally broken XLSX, DOCX, PPTX, ZIP, and PDF fixtures with SHA-256 manifests for file validation, parser, upload, and QA testing.
  • Código ao Ponto - Free browser-based test data generators and validators for Brazilian documents (CPF, CNPJ, RG, CNH) with valid check digits, plus test credit cards. No signup.
  • postal-code-formats (⭐0) - Postal code formats, validation regexes and 9,000 real sample codes for 31 countries, with every regex tested against the samples in CI.
  • ByteRivet Sample Files - Free browser-based generator for exact-size dummy files from 1 KB to 2 GB in 22 formats (PDF, PNG, JPG, DOCX, XLSX, CSV, JSON, ZIP, MP4, WAV and more) for upload-limit and file-handling tests. Files are built locally, no upload or signup.
  • StanzaAPI Test Data - Free CC0 synthetic test data for regulated B2B formats (IBAN, X12, ISO 20022, GS1, VAT, LEI, UDI, Peppol, Factur-X, CBAM, EPCIS), deterministic and check-digit-valid, as JSON and CSV.
  • FormFiller test data tools - Free browser-based generators for fake addresses, identities, IBANs, test card numbers and bulk CSV/JSON/SQL data in 22 locales.

Software / Browser Extensions & Utilities

  • Keploy API Test Recorder - Chrome extension that records API calls from your browser session and turns them into API tests.
  • Spoof Me - Test how a site behaves for users in other browsers, OSes, languages, timezones and screen sizes by switching the whole browser identity. Also available for Firefox.
  • TabQA - Connect, mirror, and control Android devices directly in Chrome via WebUSB without ADB; capture logs, inspect network requests, and record bug reproduction video buffers.

Software / Performance & Load Testing

  • telegym (⭐5) - Load testing for Telegram bots: a drop-in Bot API mock plus a k6 extension that drives virtual users.
  • k6 (⭐32k) - Modern load testing tool, scriptable in JavaScript, with cloud and open-source options.
  • JMeterHub - Interactive performance report visualizer for Apache JMeter logs with zero setup, AI conclusions, and shareable reports.
  • Locust Kubernetes Operator (⭐93) - Run distributed Locust load tests on Kubernetes with a LocustTest CRD.
  • check-proxy-tax (⭐0) - Zero-dependency CLI that samples a URL concurrently, then reports the 403 retry tax: usable-response rate and effective cost per 1,000 usable responses instead of the nominal per-1,000 price.

Software / Test Automation Frameworks

  • behave (⭐4) - Records how a command-line tool behaves (flags, stdin, exit codes, edge cases) as golden tests and replays them against another implementation, e.g. a Rust or Go rewrite.
  • VeriSpec (⭐0) - Spec-driven quality engineering framework that turns specifications into traceable test strategies, native test suites, and continuous release evidence.

Software / Screen Recording & Session Replays

  • Everframe - In-app bug reporter for mobile, web and TV apps that attaches an annotated screenshot, console, network, device info and an optional replay of the moments before the bug.

Software / Static Analysis

  • SmartBench (⭐4) - Open-source CLI for evidence-constrained code audits: deterministic static analysis owns the facts and LLM hypotheses must be validated against the code before they become findings.

Newsletters / Static Analysis
